# P03 Regulatory Gap Analysis: Cris Santos Company | Administrative and Support and Waste Management and Remediation Services | Multi-Sector: Staffing firm plus two divisions

| | |
|---|---|
| Scope at this tier | Each division's primary regulation plus group-wide obligations |
| Expected depth | Regulation-by-division matrix |
| Deliverable form | Gap tables per division plus group roadmap |
| Universal method | [step-05_P03_regulatory-gap-analysis/README.md](../../../../00_universal-framework/projects/step-05_P03_regulatory-gap-analysis/README.md) |
| Scenario brief | [README.md](../README.md) |

**Regulation to analyze:** NIST Cybersecurity Framework (CSF) 2.0, NIST CSWP 29 (CSF 2.0), voluntary
**Why:** NAICS 56 is heterogeneous (staffing/PEO, call centers, security guards, facilities services, waste) and has no sector-specific federal cyber mandate. CSF 2.0 gives one outcome-based baseline onto which the binding pieces can be mapped: FCRA/Disposal Rule for background data, HIPAA BA duties, PCI DSS for payment-taking call centers, FAR 52.204-21 for government facility-service contractors. For payment-heavy call centers, use PCI DSS v4.0.1 as the gap target instead.
